system.description: You've joined the Phoenix program under false pretenses, having developed a skilled liar's tongue and a desire to make your life better. However benign your true motives may be or how close to the truth your lie is, you've at least managed to get attached to a Stargate team, which you qualify as a success.
system.bonus: Bonus Proficiency: Deception. Low Profile: You may use Deception in place of Stealth when attempting to pass unnoticed through a populated area (such as a town or enemy base).
